'''DecipherCon 1999 Invitational''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia). Decipher scheduled it as SW.05 Deciphercon Invitational on Saturday 13 November from 2 p.m. to 8 p.m.<ref name="dc99-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Saturday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026023004/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 November 1999
* '''Site:''' Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]

A score sheet is not preserved.
